name: NVest Financial Holdings Limited
summary: NVest Financial Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides wealth management, stockbroking, and asset management services in South Africa. The company's financial services include property management, sales, leasing, and brokerage, as well as ancillary services; short-term insurance brokerage; and commercial property investment services. It offers financial advisory and intermediary services in personal and commercial lines in the short term insurance industry; and portfolio management services, as well as offers investments in direct equity/shares and listed property stocks. The company also engages in the preparation of wills, managed accounts, and the administration of deceased estates and testamentary trusts. In addition, it manages the assets of local and foreign collective investment schemes; and provides healthcare advisory, risk advisory, fiduciary, and employee benefits services. NVest Financial Holdings Limited was founded in 1985 and is based in East London, South Africa.
